The '''Three Great Works''' were a series of artifacts whose existence was noted in scrolls found on [[Rimma]] during the [[Galactic War]]. By that [[Time/Legends|time]], only two of the Great Works had been found.<ref name="TOR">{{TORcite|exp=shadow|type=crewskill|Archaeology|Two of the Three}}</ref>
